purpose: Completeness map: every apb CLI domain is classified as either a Meta Graph node we index (Layer 1 capability index) or an apb-internal concept with no Meta reference page. This is the proof that 'everything apb touches' is covered. Exact Meta reference slugs flagged verify_slug:true are best-known and confirmed when the operator saves the page HTML (on-box auto-fetch is blocked).

classification_legend.meta_node: Backed by a Meta Graph object with read/create/update/delete reference page; full capability index entry.
classification_legend.meta_read_edge: Backed by a Meta read-only edge (no create/update/delete of a node); supports_read only.
classification_legend.apb_internal: An apb concept/operation with NO Meta reference page (analysis, pipeline, local config, or an operation over another node).

domains.identity_note: Meta legacy 'campaign' = today's Ad Set. NOT 'adgroup' (which is the Ad).
Saved + lookalike audiences resolve through the same / sibling nodes (saved-audience, custom-audience lookalike).

domains.resolved_note: No classic CRUD reference node — Meta documents this only as the Conversions API + Dataset Quality API guides (not a Reading/Creating/Updating/Deleting reference page). Not indexable as a documented-mutability object; treat dataset mutations via Layer 2 / live verification.

No public CRUD reference page resolves for the value_rule_set edge. Layer 2 (verified) already covers the load-bearing facts: DELETE unsupported on all tokens + status read-only. Treat via Layer 2 / live verification.

domains.identity_note: Documented as the Page leadgen_forms edge (not a marketing-api node).
Read-only interest/behavior/geo search edges (targetingsearch, targetingbrowse, adinterest).
